entities.name: Query protein (463 aa)
observations: Sequence has strong Pfam matches to LpxC (residues 48–304) and FabA/FabZ-related region (325–447).
Homology to reviewed bacterial LpxC/FabZ proteins is 33.1–34.5% identity across about 89% of the query; functional assignment remains homology-inferred.
Related reference proteins are annotated for UDP-3-O-acyl-GlcNAc deacetylation in lipid A biosynthesis and beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP dehydration in fatty-acid biosynthesis.
Predicted likely cytoplasmic localization is transferred from bacterial homologs, not directly measured for this sequence.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: Related reviewed LpxC/FabZ homologs are annotated in lipid A biosynthesis; sequence-specific participation is inferred from homology.

entities.name: Fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: Related reviewed LpxC/FabZ homologs are annotated for beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP dehydration and fatty-acid biosynthesis; exact substrate specificity is not established for this query.
